luci-app-qnatter.description: Grant access to QNatter LuCI application (the granted ubus methods only write the qnatter UCI configuration; firewall rule cleanup is deliberately not part of this group and requires the separate luci-app-qnatter-firewall grant)

luci-app-qnatter-test.description: Grant QNatter trigger-testing privileges (the webhook/script tests execute as root and can reach arbitrary URLs; assign only to fully trusted administrators)

luci-app-qnatter-firewall.description: Grant QNatter firewall rule cleanup (removes the firewall.qnatter_<instance> auto-firewall rule left behind when an instance is renamed or deleted; the method refuses to run while an instance of that name still exists and only ever touches the qnatter_ rule namespace). This capability is separate from luci-app-qnatter because it writes the firewall UCI configuration, which that group never declares; assign only to fully trusted administrators
